components.name: Selected provider filter
components.css: .filter { font: 600 13px system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #111111; background: #111111; color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Sign-in recovery
components.description: Existing recovery action in account status.
components.css: .signin { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; background: #111111; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #111111; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 12px; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Mail card
components.description: Existing card shell and focus treatment.
components.css: .card { border: 1px solid #dadce0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; background: #ffffff; color: #111111; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .card p { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 2px; } .card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1a73e8; outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview: Factual baseline of the existing clean, minimal A v5 popup. Account identity, unread state, and fast triage lead.
dos: Render external mail as text and retain visible keyboard focus.
donts: Do not treat synthetic screenshot coverage as real-account acceptance or a completed accessibility audit.
